# vRAAS 2 Supported Aircraft

vRAAS 2 requires **MSFS 2024**. Audio callouts work with *every* aircraft, no configuration needed.
The 17 aircraft below additionally ship a tuned vRAAS 2 profile that is downloaded automatically.

**Display**: RAAS text on the PFD or ND.  
**ROP**: Runway Overrun Prevention, predictive stopping-distance alerts during landing.
